Apex National Bank - Retail Personal Loan Policy
Document ID: POL-2023-01 | Effective Date: 2023-04-01
Section 1: Scope and Definitions
This master policy governs all retail unsecured personal loans issued by Apex National Bank
across India starting April 1, 2023. All branches must strictly adhere to the eligibility criteria, interest
schedules, and penalty clauses specified below.
Clause 3.1: Applicant Eligibility
To qualify for a Retail Personal Loan, the primary applicant must be a resident Indian citizen with a
minimum age of 21 years at the time of application and a maximum age of 60 years at loan
maturity. The applicant must have a minimum net monthly income of INR 30,000.
Clause 4.2: Base Interest Rate
The standard annual interest rate applicable on all approved Retail Personal Loans shall be 9.50%
per annum on a reducing balance basis.
Clause 5.1: Late Payment Penalty
If an EMI remains unpaid beyond the 5-day grace period from the due date, a late payment penalty
of 2.0% per month shall be levied on the overdue EMI amount.

Clause 6.1: Loan Amount and Repayment Tenure
Eligible applicants may borrow between INR 50,000 and INR 15,00,000. The maximum repayment
tenure allowed under this policy is 60 months from the date of disbursement.
Clause 7.1: Schedule of Standard Fees and Charges
Fee Type Applicable Rate / Amount Remarks
Processing Fee 1.5% of Loan Amount Minimum INR 1,500
Bounce Charge INR 500 per instance For dishonoured NACH/ECS
Foreclosure Fee 3.0% of Principal Outstanding Allowed after 12 EMIs
Statement Copy Fee INR 250 Physical branch copy
Note: Policy terms may be revised periodically via official numbered bank circulars.

Apex National Bank - Regulatory Circular (First
Amendment)
Document ID: CIRC-2024-07 | Effective Date: 2024-04-01 | Amends: POL-2023-01
(DocA_Loan_Policy_2023.pdf)
Subject: Revision of Interest Rate and Late Payment Penalty
Pursuant to revised funding costs, this circular formally amends Document ID POL-2023-01 (Retail
Personal Loan Policy dated 2023-04-01) with effect from April 1, 2024.
Amendment to Clause 4.2 (Base Interest Rate)
Clause 4.2 of POL-2023-01 is hereby superseded. Effective April 1, 2024, the standard annual
interest rate applicable on all Retail Personal Loans is revised from 9.50% per annum to 10.50%
per annum on a reducing balance basis.
Amendment to Clause 5.1 (Late Payment Penalty)
Clause 5.1 of POL-2023-01 is hereby superseded. Effective April 1, 2024, the late payment penalty
for overdue EMIs beyond the 5-day grace period is increased from 2.0% per month to 3.0% per
month on the overdue EMI amount.
Unchanged Provisions
All other clauses of POL-2023-01, including eligibility and fee schedules, remain unchanged unless
modified by a subsequent circular.

Apex National Bank - Regulatory Circular (Second
Amendment)
Document ID: CIRC-2025-12 | Effective Date: 2025-04-01 | Amends: CIRC-2024-07
(DocB_Circular_2024.pdf)
Subject: Further Revision of Retail Personal Loan Interest Rate
This circular formally amends Document ID CIRC-2024-07 (First Amendment dated 2024-04-01),
which had previously amended POL-2023-01. The changes below take effect on April 1, 2025.
Amendment to Clause 4.2 (Base Interest Rate)
Clause 4.2 as amended by CIRC-2024-07 is hereby superseded. Effective April 1, 2025, the
currently applicable standard annual interest rate on Retail Personal Loans shall be 11.25% per
annum on a reducing balance basis.
Retention of Late Payment Penalty
The late payment penalty of 3.0% per month established under CIRC-2024-07 remains active and
unchanged.

Apex National Bank - Digital Sourcing Partner
Addendum
Document ID: ADD-2025-03 | Effective Date: 2025-05-01
Section 1: Digital Loan Origination Terms
This addendum defines operational guidelines for Retail Personal Loans sourced through
authorized digital lending partners.
Clause 2.1: Borrower Age Requirement
Every applicant applying for a Retail Personal Loan must have a minimum age of 25 years at the
time of application. Applications from individuals below 25 years shall be rejected.
Clause 2.2: Maximum Loan Repayment Tenure
The maximum repayment tenure permitted for any Retail Personal Loan shall not exceed 48
months from the date of disbursement.
Clause 3.1: Digital Convenience and Late Fee Cap
Parameter Rule / Value
Digital Onboarding Fee INR 750 flat
Minimum Monthly Income INR 30,000
Grace Period for EMI 5 calendar days
